summary: Backend testing for Restaurant Mirror-Shops delivery logic + Shop/Restaurant customer-visibility gate. 24/24 pytest tests pass. Verified: anonymous listing hides Pending/Rejected shops & restaurants; owner previews their own Pending; admin bypasses filter on lists and single-doc fetch; /restaurants/mine returns seller's own regardless of status; /menu, /menu-items, /products, /products/{id} all correctly gated; PUT /api/restaurants/{id} persists delivery_mode=fixed/per_area/free with delivery_fee_usd & delivery_per_area; PUT /api/admin/restaurants/{id}/delivery-managed-by persists all three values (seller/admin/default); sellers CANNOT override delivery_managed_by through PUT /restaurants/{id}; _calculate_delivery_fee correctly resolves restaurant seller-managed fixed/per_area/free and admin fallback branch. Health endpoint healthy.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 6752 lines — still well above the 700-line guideline; split by domain (shops/restaurants/menu/products/admin) is overdue.

list_restaurants performs a second DB round-trip via get_current_user for every anon request just to detect admin — consider caching the admin flag per-request or using a lightweight optional auth dependency.
list_menu_items builds a hidden-restaurant set by scanning up to MAX_PAGE_LIMIT restaurants on every call; for larger catalogs this should be a join/aggregation or a cached bloom set.

update_restaurant silently drops delivery_managed_by for sellers (good), but does not return 403 either — a seller can be misled into thinking their PUT succeeded. Consider surfacing a warning or ignoring the field via Pydantic-side sanitization only when role != admin.
RestaurantIn has BOTH legacy `delivery_pricing` and new `delivery_mode/*` fields — two sources of truth; add a migration plan or deprecate delivery_pricing to avoid drift.
get_menu re-fetches settings twice within the same request (line 2891 and 2908) — minor micro-optimization.
seed_data_creation: Session-scoped fixture creates: 1 seller user (test_seller_<uuid>@example.com), 2 shops (Pending+Verified), 2 restaurants (Pending+Verified), and — when a matching category exists — 2 menu items and 2 products. All prefixed TEST_. Session teardown deletes users/shops/restaurants/menu_items/products where seller_id matches. Post-run Mongo scan confirms 0 leftover documents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-14 test file is idempotent and safe to re-run against production-like Atlas DB. It re-uses existing admin, mints a fresh seller user each session, and cleans up on teardown. If new visibility-gated endpoints are added, extend the seller_ctx fixture with additional resource creates + parallel gate assertions. The seller_cannot_override_delivery_managed_by test doubles as regression coverage for the update_restaurant role-branch.
